_about: check-pan called from inside the app by a builder, asking for the surepass register. Per contract §1, builders may call the actions with `register: practice` only; a request naming `surepass` is refused before any register call with NOT_SET_UP. No caller-settings record changes this. The call_log entry carries `caller: builder:<email>` (§7.4, R4.6 fix).

response.reason: Identity checks with SurePass are not set up for this caller.
